name: @lopezpetergabriel/pi-extensions
description: Pi extensions, skills, and agents by lopezpetergabriel
author: lopezpetergabriel

scripts.bootstrap: npm --prefix agent/extensions/browser ci && npm --prefix agent/extensions/ccc-search ci && npm --prefix agent/extensions/filechanges ci && npm --prefix agent/extensions/subagents ci && npm --prefix agent/extensions/workflow-modes ci
scripts.check: npm run check:workspace && npm run check:package && npm run check:docs
scripts.test: npm run check && node scripts/test-release-branch.mjs && npm run test:ask-user-question && npm run test:claude-bridge && npm run test:bridge-client && npm run test:extensions && npm run typecheck && npm run test:cursor && npm run test:cursor-kit
scripts.test:ask-user-question: npx --yes tsx agent/extensions/ask-user-question/test/test_queue.ts && npx --yes tsx agent/extensions/ask-user-question/test/test_defer.ts && NODE_PATH=agent/extensions/subagents/node_modules npx --yes tsx agent/extensions/ask-user-question/test/test_relay.ts
scripts.test:claude-bridge: npx --yes tsx agent/extensions/claude-bridge/test/test_mailbox.ts && npx --yes tsx agent/extensions/claude-bridge/test/test_presence.ts && npx --yes tsx agent/extensions/claude-bridge/test/test_build_lease.ts
scripts.test:extensions: npm --prefix agent/extensions/browser test && npm --prefix agent/extensions/ccc-search test && npm --prefix agent/extensions/engineering-docs test && npm --prefix agent/extensions/personal-memory test && npm --prefix agent/extensions/subagents test && npm --prefix agent/extensions/workflow-modes test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix agent/extensions/browser run typecheck && npm --prefix agent/extensions/ccc-search run typecheck && npm --prefix agent/extensions/personal-memory run typecheck && npm --prefix agent/extensions/subagents run typecheck && npm --prefix agent/extensions/workflow-modes run typecheck
